name: draw_text_list_panel
description: Measures the longest string in a list to size and place a panel within 320 pixels, draws its frame and one line per entry, adds an image chosen by each entry's marked state, and clears the stored line records.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:4392
name: scroll_list_rows_then_reset
description: Scrolls the drawn list upward eight pixels at a time while its position is above a limit, redrawing each row's entries. It then clears two record tables, resets the list pointers and marks the selection as none.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:4560
name: layout_text_list_entries
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of text strings and lays out records for each, drawing rows sized by half the string length and recording each string's position. It then stores the final entry count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:46FA
name: get_selected_list_value
description: Returns the value of the currently selected list entry when its flag is set, then clears the selection and calls the highlight routine with fixed arguments 19 and 23.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:4782
name: set_list_entry_highlight
description: Stores the pointer of a chosen list entry into a slot, sets a highlight byte to 25 or 0 depending on the second argument, and calls the display routine at the entry's stored position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:47DC
name: track_list_hover_highlight
description: Works out which list row and which eight-pixel item band the pointer is over, moves the highlight when either changes, and clears the highlight when the pointer leaves the list area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:4914
name: draw_padded_list_label
description: Copies a list entry's text into a fixed-width buffer padded with spaces, then draws it on the entry's row using a highlight colour when the entry's flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:49F8
name: alternate_entry_with_random_offset
description: Alternates between two prepared entries on each call and, when the state flag is set, passes a small offset derived from another routine's result to a routine, then updates the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:4B1A
name: draw_grid_cell_highlight_frame
description: Converts a grid cell index into clipped screen bounds using position tables and, when the second argument is set, draws a five-plane cell frame with outlined edges, adding a second frame when a neighbouring cell is highlighted. The listing is truncated partway through.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:50A4
name: fill_rows_with_stepped_bounds
description: Sets the drawing bounds from the first argument and repeatedly draws rows across the second rectangle, stepping the height by 812 divided by the row size, until the rectangle is covered.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5138
name: shuffle_mask_table_and_apply
description: Shuffles the first sixteen entries of a word table using values from a routine, then for each of sixteen rows ANDs five planes of the picture with table entries offset by the row, and clears the record's flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:51D2
name: apply_mask_table_across_rows
description: Continues the masking pass by ANDing each picture word with a cycling entry of the shuffled table, moving through the planes and rows until all sixteen rows are processed, then clears the record's flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5250
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns without doing any work; it is an empty routine referenced from a data table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5258
name: wait_port_until_code_104
description: Waits on a message port, takes each message and replies to it, and returns only after a message whose code is 104 has arrived.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5262
name: wait_port_until_flag
description: Waits on a message port, takes each message and replies to it, and sets a completion flag when a message whose code is 104 arrives, looping until that flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:538A
name: open_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics library and then the intuition library, reporting 'unable to open' with the library name for whichever fails. If intuition fails, the graphics library is closed again.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:543E
name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens a screen, then a window on it, reporting 'unable to open a screen' or 'unable to open a window' on failure and closing the screen again if the window cannot be opened. It then sets up the drawing pointers and reserves 250 bytes of working memory.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5538
name: load_32_colours_to_screen
description: Loads 32 colour entries from the supplied table into the screen's viewport.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5554
name: load_default_32_colours
description: Loads the built-in table of 32 colour entries into the screen's viewport.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5570
name: close_screen_and_window
description: Closes the window and then the screen opened earlier.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:558C
name: close_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Closes the intuition and graphics libraries that were opened earlier.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:55A8
name: format_number_into_buffer
description: Writes a decimal number into a text buffer: zero becomes the character '0', while other values are converted by another routine and written as digits. The function returns the position after the text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:55BC
name: append_digit_at_position
description: Appends one digit obtained from a routine at the current text position, after first using two routines to prepare that position, and returns the advanced position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:55F6
name: index_active_grid_cells
description: Scans a 64-cell grid of flags and, for each set cell, records its position in two index tables and calls a routine with that cell's pointer entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:569A
name: compute_scaled_point_between
description: Computes the x and y coordinates of a point scaled between a start point and an end point, rounding each to the nearest integer, and stores them in two output words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5726
name: compute_grid_point_coordinates
description: Maps a grid point to screen coordinates by scaling its column and row by the cell size with rounding, adding the origin offsets, and stores the x and y results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:577A
name: compute_grid_row_coordinate
description: Computes the screen y coordinate of a grid row by scaling it by the cell size with rounding and adding the origin offset, then stores the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:57A8
name: record_event_in_ring_buffer
description: Stores a four-byte event in a 32-entry circular buffer, adds it to the list for its kind, sets a flag for the cell it refers to, and returns the new buffer position. A kind value of 3 with changed values also triggers two further routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:57DE
name: append_event_to_ring_buffer
description: Records an event from register values in the same 32-entry circular buffer, linking it into the list for its kind and advancing the buffer position. A kind value of 3 with changed values also triggers two further routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:57F4
name: append_event_with_flag_update
description: Sets the flag for the cell an event refers to unless its kind is 8, then stores and links the event into its kind list in the 32-entry buffer and advances the position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5856
name: link_event_at_list_tail
description: Walks a linked list of event indices to its end, appends the newest buffer index there, and writes the event fields into the current slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5872
name: store_event_and_link_slot
description: Writes the newest buffer index into the link of the given kind, fills in the event's fields, and sets its flag when a kind-3 event has changed values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:58DC
name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:58F2
name: record_event_pair_in_buffer
description: Stores a pair of event values in the next slot of a 32-entry ring buffer, sets the matching cell flag, and saves the new position in a global. A value of 5 selects one of two state bytes instead of a flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:596A
name: set_state_from_table_entry
description: Looks up an entry in an eight-entry table using the low three bits of its argument, stores that entry as the current state byte, and returns the status byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:5980
name: set_cell_flag_for_event
description: Sets the flag for the cell referred to by the event unless its kind is 8, then returns the current state byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:59B6
name: dispatch_event_by_kind
description: Creates a timed event record for a cell and dispatches on its kind from one to seven, filling in its timing, position and state fields and updating the cell's state bits. The listing is truncated partway through the kind-7 branch.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:611A
name: append_record_to_list
description: Appends a record to the end of a singly linked list whose head is stored in a global, clears the record's link, and returns the previous head.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6134
name: link_record_at_tail
description: Walks to the end of a linked list and attaches the given record there, clearing its own link.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6140
name: link_record_after_node
description: Stores one record as the successor of another and clears the new record's link.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6150
name: unlink_record_from_list
description: Finds the given record in the list, replaces the link that points to it with the record's successor, then passes the record to a follow-up routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6186
name: process_event_list_by_kind
description: Walks the event list and passes each record to the handler for its kind, from one to eight. When a handler reports completion, the cell's state byte is cleared and a follow-up routine runs; the result is one when the list is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6290
name: advance_sprite_frame_sequence
description: Advances a record through its frame sequence: on the first pass it counts frames up to a terminator and sets the start position from a table, and on later passes it draws the next frame. It returns one once the frame index reaches the count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:62B2
name: advance_sprite_frame_sequence_direct
description: Performs the same frame-sequence step as its neighbour without the initial check, then writes the advanced sequence pointer back to the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:62E0
name: start_frame_sequence
description: Starts a frame sequence on a record by counting frames up to the terminator, marking the record active, setting its start position from a table and calling a display routine with that position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6306
name: start_fixed_length_sequence
description: Sets the record's length field to 8 and its step counter to 1, takes a start position from the table, draws that position and clears the record's active flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6326
name: advance_sequence_pointer_position
description: Reads the next table entry as a position, calls a display routine with it, clears the record's active flag and stores the advanced table pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:638E
name: step_frame_until_length
description: Draws the next frame of a sequence and increments its step counter while the counter is below the record's length. Otherwise it copies the final position into the record and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:63C8
name: draw_next_sequence_frame
description: Draws the next frame of a sequence from its table entry and step counter, increments the counter and stores the updated table pointer, with no end check.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:648E
name: mark_record_active_store_pointer
description: Sets the record's active flag to one, stores the updated table pointer and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6712
name: compare_typed_text_with_record
description: Shows the 'Quartex 1988:' heading and builds string tables from the data, picks a record using a value from a routine, and displays its fields. It then reads a typed string and counts a mismatch when it differs from the stored text, ignoring letter case.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6A04
name: advance_sequence_with_frame_count
description: Counts the frames of a sequence once at the start and draws one step per call. It returns one when the step count reaches the sequence length, and otherwise stores the advanced pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6A34
name: step_sequence_report_finished
description: Draws one step of a frame sequence, counting its frames on the first call, and returns true once the step counter reaches the sequence length, storing the pointer until then.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6A68
name: count_and_step_sequence
description: Counts the frames of a sequence up to its terminator, draws the next step and returns true once the step counter reaches the sequence length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6A82
name: step_sequence_with_given_length
description: Sets the sequence length from a value passed in, draws one step, and returns true when the step counter reaches that length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6B0A
name: step_sequence_mark_active
description: Draws one step of a sequence, sets the record's active flag to one, and returns true once the sequence is finished, storing the pointer until then.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6BA6
name: store_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores a saved pointer value into the record and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6BB0
name: advance_table_driven_step
description: Advances a table-driven step: when its delay counter is clear it draws the next table entry and sets an active flag, returning one at the end marker. Otherwise it counts the delay down by one and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6BD0
name: advance_table_step_until_end
description: Draws the next entry of a table-driven sequence, starting from the first entry when the pointer is null, and returns true at the end marker, storing the pointer otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6C30
name: draw_table_entry_until_end
description: Draws the next table entry, sets the record's active flag, and returns true once the end marker is reached, storing the pointer until then.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:6C90
name: store_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores a saved pointer value into the record and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:71CC
name: run_text_command_script
description: Processes a script of byte pairs: while the next byte is 128 or more and not the terminator, it calls a routine with a slot from a table and the next byte minus 64. It then reads a delay counter and returns once the script is ready.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:71E8
name: run_text_command_script_step
description: Runs the same command script as its neighbour in a single step, processing byte pairs whose value is 128 or more, then reads the next delay byte. It always returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7246
name: read_next_script_delay
description: Reads the next script byte into the record's counter field, clearing the counter at the terminator marker, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:725A
name: read_script_byte_into_counter
description: Reads the next script byte into the counter field, advances the script pointer and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7268
name: clear_status_byte_return_one
description: Clears the status byte of the record and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7272
name: redraw_cell_and_partner
description: Takes a record of position and type values, optionally redraws a second cell for type 1 at a shifted position, then draws the record's cell and clears its occupancy flag. For type 6 it also redraws and clears a companion cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:72DA
name: redraw_cell_from_record
description: Redraws a cell from a record's position and type and clears its occupancy flag. When a type-6 flag is set it also redraws and clears a companion cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7604
name: query_cell_occupancy
description: Converts a position into a cell index, then passes the cell's occupancy bit and index to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7660
name: store_cell_state_and_index
description: Combines the kind of the given value with a state derived from its kind and row position, stores that state and the cell's index in the cell arrays, and calls a routine with the cell's table entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:774E
name: clear_work_area_reset_timer
description: Clears a 512-entry work area, reads a timer value and picks a mask from the low bit of a global, stores the mask and a reset counter, then adds the elapsed difference to an accumulated timer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:77D2
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Builds a Huffman decoding table from 256 word pairs, where each pair gives a code length and a code value. Short codes fill every matching table entry, and longer codes add second-level entries, and the finished table is copied back over the pair list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:77FC
name: check_flag_and_store
description: Calls routines to test a condition flag. When the flag is set it returns the shifted result of three calls, otherwise it stores the returned value and a register value into the table indexed by the index register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:783E
name: accumulate_timer_on_match
description: Returns unchanged unless bit 0 of the flag word is set and two address values match. In that case it adds their difference to an accumulated timer and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7852
name: assemble_byte_over_eight_steps
description: Assembles a byte over eight iterations, shifting it left each time and setting its lowest bit when the result is non-zero, and calls a routine on every iteration.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7922
name: decode_huffman_bytes
description: Decodes a given number of bytes from a bit stream using the Huffman table built earlier, reading more bits as needed and storing each decoded byte at the output position. It returns the number of bytes decoded.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7A3A
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns without doing any work; the routine is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7A4C
name: read_word_or_accumulate_timer
description: If the flag word is non-zero it returns the value from the input word. Otherwise it adds 512 to an accumulated timer, calls a routine and returns the word the pointer refers to.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7A94
name: decode_huffman_bytes_to_end
description: Decodes Huffman-coded bytes from the bit stream into the output buffer until the requested count is reached, reading bits as needed and returning the final output pointer. It writes a zero byte to finish when the count is even.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7BD8
name: start_bit_stream_at_pointer
description: Clears the decoding flag, reads the next byte or word from the stream pointer depending on its alignment, and sets the bit buffer and a mask shifted by the given count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7C1A
name: add_stream_offset_to_timer
description: Adds to the accumulated timer the distance between a stored address plus 512 and the current pointer, minus the count argument, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7C34
name: reset_decoder_state
description: Initialises a block of decoder state with the fixed value 67108864, calls three routines to set it up, and clears a word flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7C5A
name: dispatch_by_mode_value
description: Calls a routine and then dispatches on a mode value: modes 0, 1 and 2 each call a different routine and return its result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7C8C
name: set_two_flags_and_start
description: Calls two routines, sets two state words to one, runs a routine, and when a second mode word is zero calls two more routines before a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7CCE
name: push_history_record
description: Shifts up to 105 eight-byte records in a history list down by one, then writes a new record built from two globals into the list head and the following slot, resetting the head to minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7D3C
name: insert_record_at_history_head
description: Moves the history records one slot along, decrementing the head index, then writes a new record built from two globals into the first slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7D96
name: reset_round_state
description: Resets a set of round counters and flags to their start values, sets one timer from a flag, sets a mode word from a state table lookup, and calls routines to finish the setup. A fixed value of 188743680 is passed to one of them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7E28
name: clear_state_words_after_loop
description: Runs a loop of four routine calls eight times, then clears one state word and sets another to one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7EBA
name: reset_history_head
description: Sets the history head index to minus one and copies two globals into the slot after it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7ED4
name: store_pair_bytes_at_index
description: Writes the high and low bytes of the first argument into a four-byte table entry chosen by the low word of the second argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7F00
name: run_timed_state_until_event
description: Clears two timer words and, when a routine reports an active state, sets a flag and loops calling routines and a timer until an event code is returned. Otherwise it runs a single routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7F96
name: dispatch_state_action_code
description: Switches on a state code and runs the matching action: codes 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 11, 14, 15 and 18 each call a different set of routines, and the state code is reset afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:7FAC
name: reset_state_after_routines
description: Calls two routines, resets the state code to zero, and calls one more routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:81DC
name: run_mode_until_flag_clears
description: Repeatedly dispatches on a mode index to one of three routines, repeating while the state flag is two and the selected table entry is one. It then clears the flag and returns the last result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8230
name: run_state_check_and_reset
description: Resets the history count and state, then either clears the active flag or, when a timer check passes, runs a routine with the flag set and compares two state words. Finally it sets the history head to minus one and the mode to one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:82DE
name: handle_turn_and_resignation
description: Runs one turn of the move loop by resetting the animation pointers, then either plays the pending move's piece animation or checks the side-to-move state. When the game ends by resignation it shows the message 'Blue resigns' or 'Red resigns' depending on the side.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:84C4
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns without doing any work; the routine is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:84CC
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns without doing any work; the routine is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:84D4
name: pick_random_count_and_reset
description: Uses a value from a routine to find a count in a lookup table and calls a routine that many times. It then uses a six-bit value from another routine to repeat a call, resets two state words and copies two globals into a record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:857E
name: play_queued_move_entries
description: Plays queued move entries by setting an animation flag and calling routines for each entry until the queue's flag ends. It then processes the entries up to the saved index and sets the wait counter to zero, or to 200 when a further entry remains.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:865A
name: match_queued_entry_and_draw
description: Advances the queue counter. Below the stored limit it sets a pending flag, otherwise it scans the input for a value matching the expected code and draws the matching squares of the stored entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:874A
name: read_balanced_input_sequence
description: Reads an input value and, when it is below 128, reads further bytes until a balance count of flagged bytes returns to zero. It then checks the final value against 63 and returns the decoded result, or returns the value directly when it is 128 or more.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:87BA
name: wait_for_flagged_input_value
description: Repeatedly reads an input value, calling a routine between reads, until one of the values has bit 6 set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:87DA
name: skip_input_until_balanced
description: Reads input values, raising a balance counter for values of 128 or more and lowering it for values with bit 6 set, and returns once the counter is back to zero. The offset counter is decremented on each pass.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8818
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns without doing any work; the routine is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8820
name: record_start_timer_value
description: Reads the current timer value from a routine and stores it in two timer slots, marking the start of a timed interval.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8838
name: record_elapsed_timer_interval
description: Reads the timer again, stores the value as the end time and computes the elapsed interval from the start time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8858
name: add_elapsed_time_to_slot
description: Calls a routine, then adds the last measured elapsed interval to the accumulator for the slot named by the word argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8876
name: forward_two_parameters
description: Passes two parameters directly to another routine without changing them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:888E
name: store_pending_entry_and_call
description: Copies two pending global values into the list slot after the current head and into two more globals, then calls a routine with that slot's values. The listing is unreached code from a gap in the executable.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:88DE
name: advance_move_and_swap_sides
description: Advances the history index and move count, calls a routine with the two parameters, then swaps the two stored side-to-move values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8916
name: undo_move_and_swap_sides
description: Swaps the two stored side-to-move values back, calls a routine with the two parameters, then decrements the move count and history index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8950
name: read_side_value_between_calls
description: Calls a routine with the two parameters, reads a value indexed by the current side, calls the routine again with the same parameters and returns the value read.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:89AC
name: dispatch_game_command_word
description: Dispatches a command word by its low byte: codes 3 and 7 run a routine, codes 8 and 9 set or clear a flag, and code 10 toggles a flag. Codes 12 and 13 set the state for each side and may advance the turn, and codes 16 and 17 enable or disable an option. It returns the next result word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8B1E
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns without doing any work; the routine is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8B26
name: call_global_function_pointer
description: Invokes a routine through a function pointer stored in a global data structure. The listing is unreached code from a gap in the executable.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8CCA
name: update_phase_timer
description: Updates the phase state from the command byte. Phase 0 sets a delay of six, phase 10 calls a routine and either restores the previous phase or uses its result as the delay, and other phases set a delay of five shifted by the phase number and clear two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8CEE
name: resume_phase_or_set_delay
description: Handles the same phase delays as its neighbour using the saved phase value. Phase 10 calls a routine and restores the saved phase when nothing comes back, otherwise the delay is set to five shifted by the phase number and two counters are cleared.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8D0E
name: restore_saved_phase
description: Restores the saved phase value from the stack slot into the current phase state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8D16
name: set_phase_delay_from_state
description: Sets the delay to five shifted left by the phase number minus one and clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8D32
name: start_delay_with_minimum
description: Sets two state words, copies the current delay into the timer and raises the timer to at least three.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8D5C
name: copy_byte_array
description: Copies a count of bytes from the source pointer to the destination pointer, one byte at a time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8D84
name: compare_byte_strings_counted
description: Compares up to a given number of bytes from two buffers and returns zero when they match, or the difference between the first pair of mismatching bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8DC4
name: refresh_display_markers
description: Clears the text fields of each list to spaces, sets display flags for the current side, phase and options, and writes plus-sign markers at the positions for the sides and the selected squares.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:8F9E
name: build_square_occupancy_bitmap
description: Clears a bitmap buffer and, for each queued entry matching the given value, sets the bit for the square that entry refers to when a routine returns zero. A counter is incremented before the loop and decremented after it.
